description: Independently pinned SHA-256 digests of the exact release assets scripts/install-msb-runtime.sh downloads for the pinned Microsandbox runtime (internal/sandboxexecutor/backend_msb.go PinnedMSBVersion). The upstream checksums.sha256 verifies transit integrity from the release; this file is the trust anchor — a release whose assets AND checksums were substituted together still fails because the downloaded bytes cannot match these repository-pinned digests. Every digest was established by hashing the actual downloaded asset bytes, not copied from the checksum manifest. A pinned version change requires updating this file AND the executor's PinnedMSBVersion in the same change.
